newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Furman Selz starts telecom services.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Furman Selz starts telecom services.

text.p: -- Furman Selz analyst W. Todd Scott initiated coverage of six telecommunication services companies on Thursday.
-- Scott rated Brooks Fiber Properties Inc, Intermedia Communications Inc and Teleport Communications Group Inc with buy ratings and the stocks were added to the firm's recommended list.

-- In a report, Scott said Brooks Fiber could "nearly double" over the next 12-18 months as it improves market share and profitability. He expects volume growth to 150,000 lines in service at year end, up from 21,000 at the end of 1996 and sees operating cash flow turning positive in Q2 1998.
-- He started GST Telecommunications Inc, ICG Communications Inc, and McLeod Inc with neutral ratings.
